tool.name: run_monitoring_coverage
tool.description: Validate monitoring-well point geometry, count exact duplicate coordinates, dissolve all points, compute one QGIS convex hull, and convert it to GeoJSON. Report CRS-aware hull area and perimeter. This geometric coverage is not an aquifer boundary or groundwater influence area.

semantics.description: GeoJSON polygon of the convex hull around unique monitoring-well point coordinates; exact duplicate coordinates do not change the hull.
semantics.crs: GeoJSON RFC 7946 longitude/latitude (OGC:CRS84), converted from the input CRS by data.convert.
limitations: The convex hull is not an aquifer boundary, groundwater influence area, pumping capture zone, or proof of hydraulic connection.
The hull interior does not demonstrate monitoring completeness and is sensitive to the outermost wells.

semantics.description: Diagnostic summary of input and unique point counts, exact duplicate count, source CRS, hull geometry, and area in square metres plus perimeter in metres. Geographic CRS measurements are geodesic on the CRS ellipsoid; projected CRS measurements are planar and converted from declared axis units to metres.
semantics.crs: The source CRS used for hull measurement is recorded in the summary crs field.
limitations: Duplicate coordinates are reported and ignored for hull geometry; they are not evidence of additional spatial coverage.
Area and perimeter describe only a two-dimensional geometric convex hull, not an aquifer boundary or groundwater influence area.
